blocks.heading: GROUP NEWS

items.text: “Hierarchical Engineering of Atomically Precise Gold Nanoclusters from Alloying to Cluster-Assembled Frameworks” is out in [JACS](https://doi.org/10.1021/jacs.6c13448)! Congratulations, Dr. Kyoung Chul Park and Seong-Hyeon!
Sharing our work on lithography-compatible conductive MOFs for electronics, now out in [Advanced Materials](http://doi.org/10.1002/adma.75003)!
Dayon, and Juhyun joins the group as graduate students! Welcome!

“Geometry-Dependent Linker Spin States and Real-Space Band Topology in Two-Dimensional Conductive Metal–Organic Frameworks” is now out in [ACS Materials Letters](https://doi.org/10.1021/acsmaterialslett.6c00213)! Congratulations, Geunchan!

“Sequential Zn2+-H+ storage in a 2D conductive metal-organic framework for advanced aqueous zinc-ion battery” has been published in [Chem](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2451929426001956)! Geunchan, Gyuwon, and Kangmin, Congratulations!
Geonu Lee joins our group! Welcome!

“Homoconjugation-Enabled Kagome Bands in a Layer-Decoupled Two-Dimensional Conductive Triptycene-Based Metal–Organic Framework” is out in [JACS](https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/jacs.6c00558)! Congratulations, Geunchan, Sangwon, and Jaekyung!
FIMCL moves to KAIST!
Jaekyung wins the encouragement prize at the Samsung Humantech Paper Awards! Congratulations!

Yuri Jeong joins our group! Welcome!

“Chiral reticular frameworks as emerging spin filters” is now published in [Trends in Chemistry](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2589597425002801?dgcid=author). Good work, Seong-Hyeon!

“Tunable collinear-to-canted antiferromagnetic transition in Co(II)-based MOFs through structural control of linker length” has been published in [Inorganic Chemistry Frontiers.](https://pubs.rsc.org/en/content/articlelanding/2026/qi/d5qi01974e) Congratulations, Gyuwon!
New graduate student Surin Kim joins the group! Welcome!

“Tuning the Electrical Properties through Metal-Ion-Mediated Assembly in Au25 Nanocluster-Based Frameworks” is out in [JACS](https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/jacs.5c06695)! Nice work, Dr. Sinhyeop Kim and Dr. Kyoung Chul Park!

“Metal–Organic Framework/Au Core/Shell Nanocubes for Spatially Aligned Molecular Analysis and Molecular-Fingerprint Sensing with Surface-Enhanced Raman Scattering” was published in [JACS](https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/jacs.5c05420)! Congratulations, Munjeong!
Sinhyeop successfully defends his doctor’s thesis and becomes the very first PhD graduate from out group!
Soomin successfully defends her master’s thesis and becomes the nineth master’s graduate from our group!

Good news, everyone! “Synthesis of Au13Cu4 Nanoclusters with Isomeric Mercaptobenzoic Acid Ligands” is now published in [Nano Letters](https://pubs.acs.org/doi/full/10.1021/acs.nanolett.5c01792)! Munjeong and Sinhyeop, congratulations!

Hyebeen, Geunchan, Jaekyoung’s paper, “Uninterrupted π-d Conjugated Three-Dimensional Conductive Metal–Organic Framework” has been published in [ACS Materials Letters! ](https://doi.org/10.1021/acsmaterialslett.5c00244)Great work!
Jiwon wins the Best TA award from the General Chemistry course! Great job, Jiwon!

Congratulations, Yeji Lee, Hyerin Woo, and Soomin Hwang! “Zwitterionic polymer intertwined metal-organic framework-based quasi-solid-state electrolyte for long cycle life dual-ion batteries” is now published in [Chem](https://www.cell.com/chem/fulltext/S2451-9294(24)00647-8)!
Gyuwon successfully defends her master’s thesis and becomes the eighth master’s graduate from our group!
Sinhyeop and Gyuwon win the Oustanding Paper Award! Congrats!
Jaemin wins the Best TA award in General Chemistry course! Great job, Jaemin!
Gyuwon wins the poster award at 2024 PSBT program workshop! Congrats!

Great news! Our new paper on molecular-level pore tuning in 2D conductive MOF for advanced supercapacitor performance is now published in [JACS](https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/jacs.4c11372)! Congrats to Gyuwon Lee and Geunchan Park!

Excited to share Sinhyeop Kim’s paper on photophysical properties of atomically precise gold nanocluster-based coordination frameworks is now published in [ACS Nano](https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/acsnano.4c10096)!
Geunchan and Jaekyung win the Oustanding Paper Award! Congrats!

Congratulations to Hyebeen Jeong, Geunchan Park, and Jaemin Jeon on the publication of their paper on fabricating large-area thin films of 2D conductive MOFs in the [Accounts of Chemical Research](https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/acs.accounts.4c00292)!
Hyerin successfully defends her master’s thesis and becomes the seventh master’s graduate from our group!
Hyebeen successfully defends her master’s thesis and becomes the sixth master’s graduate from our group!
The group welcomes Kyoungchul Park, our new postdoctoral fellow!

Our new paper on solvent-induced structural rearrangement in sonochemical synthesis of MOFs is now published in [Small Methods](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/smtd.202400363)! Congrats to Jaekyung Yi and Gyuwon Lee!

Glad to share the publication on electrochemical water oxidation activity in a series of bimetallic Fe,Ni-azolate MOFs in [Advanced Energy Materials](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/aenm.202401198)! Congratulations to Minseok Kim, Geunchan Park, Jaekyung Yi, and Sinhyeop Kim!

Exciting news! Geunchan Park’s paper on synthesizing a new solution-processable 2D conductive MOF with interesting acid-dependent chemistry is now published in [JACS](https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/jacs.4c02326)!
New graduate student Jiwon Park joins our lab. Welcome!

Congratulations to Soomin Hwang and Hyerin Woo on the publication of their paper on ionic conductivity in covalent organic frameworks (COFs) in the Bulletin of the Korean Chemical Society ([BKCS](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1002/bkcs.12823))!
Hyebeen wins the Best TA award in General Chemistry course! Great work, Hyebeen!
Junsoo successfully defends his master’s thesis and becomes the fifth master’s graduate from our group!
Excited to welcome our new graduate student, Jaemin Jeon!
Hyerin wins the poster award at 2023 PSBT program workshop! Congrats!
Minseok receives the best poster award at 2023 KCS Inorganic Chemistry Division Summer Symposium! Congrats!
Hayun and Yeji successfully defend their master’s theses and become the third and fourth master’s graduates from FIMCL!
Minseok successfully defends his master’s thesis and becomes the second master’s graduate from our group!
FIMCL starts a rock band, “The Band Gap”!
A very warm welcome to our new graduate students, Soomin Hwang and Gyuwon Lee!
Had an awesome end-of-year gathering at Outback Steakhouse!
Eunseol successfully defends her master’s thesis and becomes the first master’s graduate from FIMCL!
Yeji receives the Best TA award in Synthesis Laboratory course! Great job, Yeji!
Glad to share Myeonggeun Choe’s paper on synthesizing 2D MOF thin film using chemical vapor deposition method is accepted to [JACS](https://pubs.acs.org/doi/full/10.1021/jacs.2c07135). Congrats!
New graduate students Hyebeen Jeong and Hyerin Woo join our group. Welcome!
Check out our [new review](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1002/adma.202203791) from Minseok Kim, Jaekyung Yi, and Seong-Hyeon Park on MOF-based electrocatalysts!
We welcome Munjeong Kim as our newest group member!
Check out [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?ab_channel=%ED%8F%AC%ED%95%AD%EA%B3%B5%EA%B3%BC%EB%8C%80%ED%95%99%EA%B5%90%28POSTECH%29&v=-VlmNf7MqE4) to know more about FIMCL!
Enjoyed our group’s first end-of-year party with gourmet from Outback Steakhouse!
Excited to welcome our two new graduate students, Yeji Lee and Hayun Park!
A most warming welcome to our four new graduate students: Jaekyung Yi, Junsoo Ha, Geunchan Park, and Minseok Kim!
Eunseol wins the Best TA award in General Chemistry Laboratory course! Great work, Eunseol!
The group welcomes Eunseol Bae, our new graduate student!
Our lab renovations are finally complete. We will have a lab opening party! Stop by to talk research and have a snack.
Our very first graduate student, Sinhyeop Kim, joins the group. Welcome!
Sarah starts as an Assistant Professor.
